raw_record.question_text: In the figure, $m \angle 12 = 64$. Find the measure of $\angle 5$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: the two horizontal lines labeled y and z are marked parallel, and the two slanted lines labeled w and x are also marked parallel. Angle 12 is at the lower intersection of x with z, above z and to the right of x. Angle 5 is at the upper intersection of w with y, below y and to the left of w. From the text, use m∠12 = 64. Since w ∥ x and z is a transversal, ∠12 corresponds to ∠10, so m∠10 = 64. Since y ∥ z and w is a transversal, ∠10 and ∠5 are alternate interior angles, so they are congruent. Therefore m∠5 = 64.
